notes.title: Playtest Has Ended and...
notes.notes:
[p]Playtest held this weekend ended, and I leave with invaluable feedback.[/p][p]Hey good fellas, I just want to thank everybody that could join our small playtest this weekend and gave some of their thoughts about it. I'll appreciate it until my last day on earth.

If you missed out, please sign up for the upcoming Beta in the coming months:

🔗 [url="https://cutt.ly/Real-Beta-Signup"]https://cutt.ly/Real-Beta-Signup[/url][/p][p] 
See you, space cowboy.[/p]

notes.title: Playtest Available NOW!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey guys, the title explains itself. Celebrating the GDoC Expo, a small playtest for one level of Anima Shin Gun is releasing right now! Available ONLY for this weekend (UNTIL Sep 22th).

Come hang out and tell me how poor performance is going (hopefully not)[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840820/Anima_Shin_Gun" style="button"]Let's Go Playtest[/url][/p]

notes.title: Anima Shin Gun has been accepted in the GDoC Expo :D
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Guys! It's been a while. I'm still alive and constantly working on the game, and now with some great news. Anima Shin Gun will be featured during the Game Devs of Color Expo Steam Showcase starting Sep 16th 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332133/f1ebeb2ade7de4863ab2b9000554afc49b28d9f1.png"][/img]

aaaaand not only that... 

For this special date, we are gonna launch our FIRST BETA during the GDoC Expo. More details about it will be coming in the next days. Stay tuned. 

See you Space cowboy.[/p]

notes.title: So... let this journey begin
notes.notes:
If you can read this, then I owe you my life.  You have decided to join me in this game dev journey that I'm so excited for.

Please wishlist Anima Shin Gun, share and tell your friends about it. This is just the beginning.
